sections.content:

The $8.175 million in frozen assets — representing approximately 82% of the original Leon Black donation after seven years of grant-making, consulting payments, and investment activity — remains one of the larger identifiable pools of Epstein-related funds subject to estate proceedings and potential claimant recovery.
